text:
danielle: quick idea — extend rollout metadata with an 'ensemble_affinity' concept so pins can target logical ensembles (reranker+generator) instead of individual models. avoids partial rollouts that break end-to-end behavior.

omar: how would that look? show a tiny example pls.

li: +1 to the concept. keep it backward compatible: existing model pins still work. sketch: ensemble_id string + bindings list mapping role -> model_ref. runtime resolves ensemble pins first, then falls back to model pins.

danielle: sketch below (informal):
```json
{
  "ensemble_affinity": "eng/rerank-gen@v1",
  "bindings": [
    {"role": "ranker", "model": "redwood/ranker@v2"},
    {"role": "generator", "model": "redwood/gptx-11b@v3"}
  ],
  "rollout": [{"cohort": "canary", "pct": 5}],
  "pin_scope": "ensemble"
}
```

harper: precedence question — if a tenant has a pin for the generator to an older model, should the ensemble pin be blocked? my vote: tenant model pin wins unless there is an explicit 'force_ensemble' override and owner sign-off.

omar: agree. add a boolean 'allow_override' and require an audit signature for force changes. also enforce a ttl on ensemble pins so they don't outlive tests.

li: operational safety: validate bindings at pin-time for compatibility (tokenizer, input shape, output contract). reject ensemble pins that fail checks. include a 'compatibility_hint' pointer to test artifacts.

infra-bot: NOTICE: ensemble pin validation failed: tokenizer mismatch between ranker and generator bindings for request 3755554321.

danielle: good catch — runtime should refuse to apply incompatible ensembles and surface a clear error path. we'll store a pointer to the failing diffs in the audit logs, not in primary metadata.

harper: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with a clear precedence table: tenant_pin > model_pin > ensemble_pin, unless force_ensemble=true and signed_by_owner=true. include examples.

omar: can someone own the ops runbook for emergency unwraps and manual reconcile? I'll take resolver unit tests.

danielle: I'll add the compatibility API, update the schema with compact strings for SDK friendliness, and push the PR tonight. tagging you all when ready. :ship:
